entities.summary: Willie J. McCarter was an American basketball player. He was a 6-foot-3-inch (1.91 m), 175 lb (79 kg) guard. He played at Drake University, averaging 19.9 ppg in three seasons. He was drafted by the Los Angeles Lakers with the 12th pick in the 1969 NBA draft, and played three seasons with the Lakers and Portland Trail Blazers.
